name: One&Only One Za'abeel

address.street: 67GV+M3Q - Street - Za'abeel - Za'abeel 1 - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: Dubai's most architecturally stunning hotel features the world's longest cantilever, suspended dramatically 100 meters above the city skyline.
whats_special: One&Only One Za'abeel's iconic "Link" bridge connects two towers and houses the world's highest restaurant at 305 meters. The hotel sits in the heart of Za'abeel district, minutes from Dubai Frame and the historic Al Fahidi neighborhood, offering unparalleled views of both old and new Dubai.
pro_tip: Book a table at STAY by Yannick Alléno in the suspended Link for an unforgettable dining experience literally floating above Dubai's skyline.
dont_miss: The hotel's infinity pools appear to spill into the city below, while the spa offers treatments with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Dubai's glittering metropolis. The rooftop helipad provides exclusive helicopter transfers for the ultimate Dubai arrival.
pros: Iconic architecture with suspended bridge design connecting two towers
Prime location in Dubai's financial district with skyline views
Ultra-luxury amenities and world-class spa facilities
Multiple award-winning restaurants and rooftop dining experiences
cons: Business district location rather than beachfront
